skill.name: react-native-best-practices
skill.description: Guides React Native performance work across FPS, rendering, startup time, bundle size, memory usage, animations, and native tooling.
skill.summary: Optimize React Native apps with targeted performance diagnostics and proven remediation guidance.
skill.author: callstackincubator

security_audit.summary: The static findings are overwhelmingly documentation false positives from React Native performance guidance, code examples, local build commands, links, and terms such as mmap or keystroke. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or malicious automation was evident from the generated snippets. The remaining confirmed items are unscanned binary images, which require manual review because static analysis could not inspect their contents.

remediation.issue: Binary reference images were not statically scanned.
remediation.suggestion: Manually inspect or regenerate each image from trusted sources before publishing the skill.

remediation.issue: The documentation includes local build, profiling, and device command examples.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing warning that commands are local developer operations and should be reviewed before execution.

content.value_statement: React Native performance issues can span JavaScript, native code, bundles, startup, and rendering. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured guide for diagnosing and fixing those issues.
actual_capabilities: Prioritizes React Native performance work by FPS, re-rendering, bundle size, startup time, memory, animations, and native bottlenecks.
Provides guidance for Hermes memory mapping, R8 shrinking, barrel export removal, code splitting, and bundle analysis.
Explains how to use React DevTools, Flashlight, Xcode Instruments, Android Studio Profiler, and related profiling workflows.
Recommends React Native UI fixes such as FlashList usage, uncontrolled TextInput patterns, atomic state, and Reanimated worklets.
Covers native topics including Turbo Modules, threading, memory leaks, 16 KB Android page size alignment, and view flattening.
limitations: It is a guidance skill and does not automatically profile an app without project access and developer-approved tool runs.
Some recommendations depend on the React Native, Expo, FlashList, Reanimated, Hermes, iOS, and Android versions in use.
It cannot prove a performance fix without before-and-after measurements from a real device or representative emulator.
It includes local command examples that should be reviewed before execution in sensitive repositories.

use_cases.title: Diagnose frame drops in a React Native screen
use_cases.description: Identify whether jank comes from re-renders, list rendering, JavaScript work, layout depth, or native thread contention.

use_cases.title: Reduce release bundle and install size
use_cases.description: Apply bundle analysis, tree shaking, R8, asset review, Hermes settings, and import cleanup to reduce app size.

use_cases.title: Plan a native performance investigation
use_cases.description: Choose Xcode, Android Studio, Perfetto, memory profilers, or React DevTools based on the symptom and platform.

prompt_templates.title: Start a performance diagnosis
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for help with a slow React Native screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the React Native best practices skill to diagnose why this screen feels slow. Ask for the minimum details you need, then suggest the first measurements to collect.

prompt_templates.title: Improve list performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on FlatList or FlashList issues.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React Native list implementation for unnecessary re-renders, unstable props, poor item rendering, and FlashList or FlatList configuration issues.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce bundle size
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to create a bundle-size reduction plan for this React Native app. Include JavaScript bundle checks, native size checks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a full performance remediation plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the React Native best practices skill to prioritize a full performance remediation plan for FPS, TTI, memory, native threading, animations, and bundle size. Include measurement gates for each fix.

output_examples.input: Our product feed drops frames during scrolling.
output_examples.output: The assistant proposes a measurement-first plan: capture FPS, inspect re-renders, verify item key stability, review list virtualization settings, compare FlatList and FlashList behavior, and test on a release build.

output_examples.input: Our Android app startup became slower after a release.
output_examples.output: The assistant separates JavaScript startup, Hermes bundle loading, native initialization, and TTI measurement. It recommends before-and-after markers and Android profiler checks.

output_examples.input: The app binary is too large for our release target.
output: Measure app download and install size separately.
Analyze JavaScript and native bundle contributors.
Check R8, assets, tree shaking, Hermes, and large libraries.

best_practices: Measure on release builds and representative devices before and after each optimization.
Change one performance variable at a time so regressions and improvements are attributable.
Match recommendations to the project versions for React Native, Expo, Hermes, FlashList, and Reanimated.
anti_patterns: Do not add memoization, code splitting, or native rewrites without evidence from profiling.
Do not trust simulator-only results for final performance decisions.
Do not run local build, profiling, or package commands without reviewing their effect first.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically optimize my app?
faq.answer: No. It guides diagnosis and changes. You still need project access, measurements, and approved tool runs.

faq.question: Can it help with both iOS and Android?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes React Native, JavaScript, iOS, Android, Hermes, and native profiling guidance.

faq.question: Does it require the New Architecture?
faq.answer: No. Some references mention New Architecture behavior, but many recommendations apply to older and newer React Native apps.

faq.question: Can it diagnose memory leaks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes JavaScript and native memory leak investigation patterns, plus profiler guidance.

faq.question: Are the command examples safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. Treat them as local developer operations and review them before running in a repository.

faq.question: How should I verify a performance fix?
faq.answer: Collect a baseline, apply one change, retest the same interaction, and compare release-build metrics on representative devices.
